# Sai Vivek Peddi

> Founder of mlpal (https://mlpal.ai): a model gateway, a tunable harness and governed memory that companies own outright and that improves against their own evals. Open source, self-hosted or managed. Based in Mountain View, CA. Contact: svp@mlpal.ai

- [Home](https://www.svpeddi.com/): what I'm building, research, open source, background
- [Notes](https://www.svpeddi.com/notes/): essays in my own words
- [RSS](https://www.svpeddi.com/rss.xml)
